title: Selected-radial affine signs through the existing recursive kernel
decision: Retain the shared-kernel consolidation: the affine median falls 63.65 to 3.14 seconds (-95.07%) with 96.35% fewer allocations and smaller production/native/WASM code. Preserve the tangent cost (0.33 to 0.57 seconds, +72.73%) and all other recorded costs; this is not a uniform speedup. Exact geometry and policy checks remain intact. No compatibility interface, new API, cache, field, or representation is introduced. The separate opaque-tangency construction failure remains open.

environment.source_paths: One fixed snapshot path for both revisions

source.diagnosis: Stage timers isolate nearly all of the 63.61-second four-field regression cost to affine signs, not transformed bounds. The old selected-radial branch builds unreduced quadrivariate norm expressions for each query. Share the existing recursive-contact point/center frame and reduced-field affine evaluator with recursive line contacts, and delete the duplicate branch.
source.invariants: For strictly positive projective denominators Dp and Dc, the signed numerator is (a.Np+offset*Dp)*Dc+(b.Nc)*Dp. Zero center coefficients omit the second denominator product. Existing imports retain selected roots, shared field identity, positive denominators, branch validation, and requested-policy sign semantics. No Cartesian sampling or approximate terminal is introduced.
source.api: Unchanged; no new production function, scalar facade, compatibility path, representation, object field or cache.

regressions.assertions: Six unchanged interval-derived affine brackets across seven retained carrier families. The existing selected-radial tangent test additionally verifies retained-map identity and opaque-zero coordinate queries under STRICT, APPROXIMATE_512 and forced-strict replay, repeated in both chord orientations. Original and candidate both complete all strengthened tests.
regressions.timeouts: Focused invocations use a 120-second diagnostic limit; all observed exits are zero.

diagnostics.scope: Single instrumented diagnostic runs, not paired latency evidence. Production/test-module controls, frozen sources, binaries, catalogs, logs and timestamps are retained. Bounds-only optimization was rejected because the measured bounds work is milliseconds.

open_construction_probe.name: selected_radial_affine_import_preserves_opaque_tangent_provenance
open_construction_probe.finding: Original and affine candidate both enter a rational-frame-only fallback on the opaque-shifted four-field tangent. An isolated rational-frame guard prevents the topology error, but the operation remains Uncertain(Unsupported). Direct stage diagnostics show endpoint fields and the selected system construct; the contact discriminant is Uncertain(RealSign), before affine evaluation.
open_construction_probe.disposition: Preserved unchanged failed expectations for a later completeness repair. The dispatch guard, opaque construction test and speculative discriminant changes are excluded from live source. No construction completeness claim or strict-proof relaxation.

validation.scope: Seven pinned committed source archives, no live dependency symlinks. Full tests include opt-in cases. Concurrent Hyperreal drafts are excluded and untouched. No new browser run or publication.

memory.scope: Matched complete whole-libtest Heaptrack format-3 streams with equal-length binary names, reconciled final live counts and verified compression integrity; not geometry-only attribution or leak proof. Instrumented runtimes are not latency evidence.

instructions.scope: Matched whole-libtest tangent Callgrind; summary equals total. No instruction-count claim for the long affine fixture.

binary_size.scope: Same snapshot paths, dependency pins and build profiles; frozen artifacts and section tables retained.

timing.scope: Prespecified three alternating CPU-7 pairs across six unchanged geometry tests, the matched strengthened tangent fixture, two native matrices and three 1000-iteration Boolean batch fixtures. The tangent fixture was added before timing after its allocation profile showed a cost. Owned builds/profiles finish before timing. All samples retained without retries or selected subranges. A 1.5 within-binary max/min guard is reported; host scheduling, desktop activity, frequency and thermal state remain uncontrolled.

artifacts.scope: Frozen sources, archived dependencies, scripts, catalogs, binaries and all experiment/qualification/measurement logs. Rebuildable cache and temporary files excluded.
